Pet Spa TorontoDog & cat grooming · Downtown Toronto

Meet Dan

Dan is a certified cat and dog groomer who loves animal welfare and motorcycles. After earning his grooming certification in Quebec, he opened his first pet spa in Montreal in 2018. He moved to Toronto and opened Pet Spa Toronto in 2019, with one goal: a 5-star visit for every pet, every time.

Teeth cleaning

Professional dental scaling for dogs and cats, done during our clinic sessions. Call to confirm the date and time. Clinic days are Sundays.
